summary: Inventory of duplicate and overlapping models across core, orchestration, providers, storage, tools, and backend.

occurrences.structure: Ordered list of WorkflowStep objects (`steps: list[WorkflowStep]`)
Graph representation with dict of nodes and list of edges (`nodes: dict[str, WorkflowNode]`, `edges: list[WorkflowEdge]`)

duplicates.rationale: Canonical WorkflowDefinition in core will adopt the Graph model (nodes & edges) required for multi-branch and DAG execution, replacing ordered step lists.
Unify model interaction contracts in core as ModelRequest/ModelResponse while keeping transport-specific details isolated inside windagent_providers adapters.

occurrences.structure: Typed Pydantic EventEnvelope with event_id, event_type, sequence, session_id, payload
Legacy event payload dict / custom event envelope wrapper

duplicates.rationale: All event emission across orchestration, backend, worker, and storage must use core's Pydantic EventEnvelope. Legacy mappers will sit only at API/WebSocket boundaries.

occurrences.structure: BaseEntityId parent class assuming string can convert to UUID via to_uuid()
Mixed opaque string IDs and UUIDs

duplicates.rationale: Split BaseEntityId into UUIDEntityId (for domain aggregates like TaskId, SessionId, WorkflowId) and OpaqueId (for external system IDs like ProviderId, WorkerId).
